notes.title: Happy Early Access Launch Day
notes.notes:
Hello to all of our new players!

We are thrilled and excited to have finally reached launch day! Please take some time to give Meta Star a whirl, and then come back here to let us know how you like it! Remembe, the first person to beat the game names a feature in our next update. And everyone else that beats the game gets thrown into a hat, and one of those players will be picked at random to also name a feature for the next version!

One more reminder, you can report bugs on the forums, and if we are able to confirm those bugs you will be able to name any SMALL change you want to be seen made to the game!

One more time, we'd like to thank everyone for giving our (short) game a chance, and we can't wait for the coming months to see all of the changes that are made to Meta Star once the community sinks their hooks into it.

notes.title: Launching to Early Access in Two Weeks!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that we will be officially launching into Early Access in two weeks. Our team is excited and we are here to answer any questions you may have. But for now we thought we would get right into it with a little tidbit of what the future holds...

As mentioned on our store page, in addition to the player-requested updates, the development team will also be adding quality-of-life and content updates of our own. Some of the plans for the first update inlcude the ability to fast-foward through cut-scenes and the ability to get back to the main menu (and exit the game) at any point. Finally, we are planning on introducing an entirely new area for players to interact with outside v0.001's arena, which should set the stage for an even grander adventure.

We hope everyone is as excited as we are to get this experiment underway, and can't wait to begin interacting with our community.
